## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the exact commands you ran and their results.

```text
npm run check
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Shared skill changes are synchronized across `.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is reflected in the root and package documentation where needed.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private code, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Package version and release notes are updated when the change is intended for publication.
